verdict.rationale: The power-efficiency axis clearly applies to a datacenter GPU, but the pack never states a power envelope or TDP figure, gives no performance-per-watt claim, and contains no independent efficiency testing. The power-related docs cover only PSU redundancy, degraded operation on PSU loss, and the fact that nvidia-smi reports maximum per-GPU power, which are adjacent controls rather than evidence of efficiency. The 3X/15X performance claims are not normalized to power.
